configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent node >/dev/null 2>&1; exec npm "$@"
